question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**towards**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "towards a partnership" suggests the direction or goal of the intended relationship, which fits with the idea of moving toward a more equitable, shared commitment to protecting the planet.
 
• The preposition **towards** indicates a direction or movement, which fits the context of transitioning from a donor-recipient model to a partnership based on mutual goals.
 
• Other options such as **lest**, **liable**, and **behind** do not correctly convey the intended direction or transition from one model to another.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *The US is the (1) **biggest **__shareholder in the World Bank and traditionally, the bank’s president has been a US citizen (2) __**nominated **__by Washington. Small island developing states have argued for moving the fund (3) __**away **__from a donor recipient model, with all their usual power imbalances, (4) __towards__ a partnership founded on a shared commitment to protecting the planet. This will require partial or total (5)_______ of the World Bank. This is already happening under its new president, some argue. But hosting the fund within the bank would still give donor countries disproportionate influence.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Lest** refers to the idea of preventing something, which does not fit the context of a transition to a new model of partnership.
 
• **Liable** indicates responsibility or being subject to something, which is not suitable in describing the shift towards a new partnership.
 
• **Behind** indicates something occurring later or after, which does not reflect the idea of progressing towards a new goal or partnership.
